'''Anoobas''' were aggressive pack predators native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Opportunistic hunters as well as scavengers, these wolflike canines would attack virtually anything smaller than themselves (such as [[Scurrier/Legends|scurriers]]) and would band together in packs to bring down [[Ronto/Legends|rontos]], [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]], and similar creatures.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Anooba-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Anooba with [[Jakrab/Legends|jakrab]] prey]]
Strong, horny beaks on their jaws assisted in the breaking of thick [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletons]], while long, tufted tails helped to counterbalance the body and dissipate heat. Anoobas could vary in weight from 20 to 45 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]&mdash;[[Gender/Legends|males]] being larger than females&mdash;and often banded into packs of ten to twelve. These units were dominated by an alpha male and alpha female, and it was not uncommon to see entire packs waiting alongside [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] courses for an easy meal.<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide" />

Like the winged [[Urusai/Legends|urusai]], accounts spoke of anoobas being so engorged on meals that they are unable to move. This may be due in part to the fact that anooba mothers fed their young, born three to four at a time, through regurgitation.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a pack of anoobas had invaded the [[Womp rat cave]] at the [[Xelric Draw/Legends|Xelric Draw]] and caused womp rats to go wild and harrass nearby [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="Star Wars: The New Droid Army">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref>
[[File:Marrok-Bounty.jpg|thumb|230px|Marrok, the pet of the bounty hunter Embo]]
Around the same time, a pack of striped anoobas were kept at a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Citadel/Legends|prison]] on [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] by the warden [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]], who used them to hunt and track escaped prisoners. During a mission by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to rescue prisoners of war from the prison, one of these anoobas attacked and killed the [[Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell]].<ref name="Citadel rescue" /> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Embo/Legends|Embo]] had a pet anooba named [[Marrok (anooba)/Legends|Marrok]].<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty}}</ref> [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] on Tatooine, helped adopt an anooba after its previous master had treated it roughly.<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>

Packs of escaped, adaptable anoobas imported from Tatooine roamed [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] alleys looking for prey. As a result, nocturnal foot traffic in certain areas was highly risky. Anoobas on Coruscant were known to howl at the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Anoobas were sometimes caught in packs and used as gladiatorial fighting animals, for which they were given a shock collar to control their behavior.<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide" />

Anoobas were also known to be, like the [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]], domesticated by Tatooine's [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] as pets and guard animals.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Anooba-CR.jpg|thumb|240px|Anoobas in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]]]]
Originally designed as concept art for a creature in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace]]'' by [[Terryl Whitlatch]]<ref name="artofep1">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> but ultimately not included in the film. They would later on be depicted in the reference book ''"[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]],"'' released in 2001.<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide" />

The anooba would make its on-screen appearance in "[[Citadel Rescue]]," the twentieth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The episode released on [[March 11]], [[2011]].<ref name="Citadel Rescue Old Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}}</ref>
